addChildCard.title: Add a child
addChildCard.body: Enter your child's nickname and get a 6-digit code. Your child types it in on their own phone — no e-mail or password needed.

addChild.title: Add a child
addChild.privacy: We don't need an e-mail address or a surname.
addChild.privacyDetail: Your child signs in only with the code you create here.
addChild.nicknameInvalid: Enter a nickname (up to {{max}} characters, no @).
addChild.birthYearInvalid: The year must be between {{min}} and {{max}}.

createErrors.too_many_children: A family can have at most 10 children.

createErrors.offline: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
createErrors.server: The child couldn't be added right now. Please try again.

addChild.newPetHint: Your child gets their own puppy. It is born when your child signs the Responsibility Contract.
addChild.joinPetHintNames: Already cared for by {{names}}. A shared dog — each child has their own score.
addChild.joinPetHint: A shared dog — each child has their own score.
addChild.instructions: Your child opens PetPrep on their phone, chooses "I'm a kid" and types in this code.

new_pet.open: Open PetPrep on your child's phone.
new_pet.code: Your child chooses "I'm a kid" and types in the 6-digit code.
new_pet.finish: Your child signs the Responsibility Contract and the puppy is born.

join_pet.open: Open PetPrep on your child's phone.
join_pet.code: Your child chooses "I'm a kid" and types in the 6-digit code.
join_pet.finish: Your child signs their own Responsibility Contract and can then care for the dog.

relogin.open: Open PetPrep on the new phone or tablet.
relogin.code: Your child chooses "I'm a kid" and types in the 6-digit code.
relogin.finish: The dog and the progress stay the same.

addChild.reloginNote: A child can be signed in on up to 3 devices — on the fourth, the oldest one is signed out.
addChild.expired: The code has expired. Create a new one.
addChild.waiting: Waiting for your child to enter the code …
addChild.oneTime: The code works only once. A new code cancels the previous one.

pairedBody.new_pet: {{name}} can now sign the Responsibility Contract on their phone — that's when the puppy is born.
pairedBody.join_pet: {{name}} can now sign their own Responsibility Contract and then care for the dog.
pairedBody.relogin: {{name}} is signed in on the new device. The dog is still the same.

quietHours.title: Quiet hours
quietHours.hint: During quiet hours the dog hardly gets hungry, makes no mess and sends no notifications. Times follow the family's time zone.

notifications.title: Notifications

status.on: On — this phone gets an alarm when your child hasn't cared for the dog for over an hour, and news about illness or the shelter.
status.off: Off — you'll only find out about a neglected dog when you open the app.
status.blocked: Turned off in the phone's settings.

notifications.quietHours: Nothing is sent during quiet hours. Notifications never include children's names.
